name: my-iptv
description: IPTV player — Capacitor shell around the HTML/JS app in www/

scripts.sync: npm run vendor && npm run patch && npx cap sync android
scripts.open: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.apk:linux: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.bundle: npm run sync && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
scripts.bundle:linux: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
